extName.message: Social Links – right-click open, copy & add

extDescription.message: Keep your LinkedIn, GitHub and other profile links one right-click away on any website. Paste, copy, open or add — no access to your browsing.

lblQr.message: QR code containing your contact card

emptyState.message: No links in this profile yet. Click + Add, or right-click any profile link on a website and choose Social links › + Add / ✎ Edit › + Add this link.

warnLocal.message: Too many links to sync, so they're saved on this computer only. Back up to keep them safe.

modeMerge.message: Merge — add new links, keep mine

qrHint.message: Scan with a phone camera to save $1 link(s) as a contact.

qrEmpty.message: Add some links first — the card is empty.

qrDense.message: This card is very detailed and some phone cameras may struggle. Download the vCard instead, or use fewer links.

qrTooLong.message: Too many links for one QR code. Download the vCard instead.

tipFooter.message: Right-click in a text box › Social links to paste a link, or anywhere to open, copy or add. Alt+Shift+L opens this panel.

confirmDeleteProfile.message: Delete the profile “$1” and its $2 link(s)? Back up first if you might want them again.

errEmail.message: That doesn't look like an email address.

errNotProfile.message: That's a $1 link, but not a profile page.

errNeedUrl.message: Please paste a full web address starting with https://

errUsername.message: Usernames can use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.

errDuplicate.message: You've already saved this link in this profile.

errProfileExists.message: There's already a profile with that name.

errProfileMax.message: You can have up to 20 profiles.

errBackupShape.message: That file isn't a Social Links backup.

errBackupSize.message: That file is too large to be a backup.

toastCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy — your browser blocked it

tipIcons.message: Shows the real icon for Other links. Chrome will ask for permission to read website icons.

toastUndoGone.message: Can't undo: that profile was deleted.

omniUsage.message: Type a link name to open it, copy <name> to copy it, or manage to edit your links
omniUsage.description: Address bar (after typing sl and a space): default hint

omniOpen.description: Address bar suggestion; $1 is the link name and address

omniCopy.description: Address bar suggestion; $1 is the link name and address

omniManage.message: $1: open Social Links to add, edit or reorder links
omniManage.description: Address bar suggestion; $1 is the word manage

omniNoMatch.message: No link matches "$1". Try a site name, copy <name>, or manage
omniNoMatch.description: Address bar: nothing matched what was typed ($1)

omniNoLinks.message: No links in $1 yet. Press Enter to add some
omniNoLinks.description: Address bar: active profile ($1) has no links
